excerpt.quote: **Scientific adequacy: supported. Reported hypothesis outcome: not supported by corrected positive vmPFC evidence.** The conclusion in `report.md` is appropriately limited to lack of corrected evidence, not proof of zero effect. The reported vmPFC mean is −0.00051 map-estimate units (95% descriptive t interval −0.0222 to 0.0212), and no vmPFC voxel survives positive one-sided whole-brain max-T FWE correction. The 24 FWE-significant positive voxels are posterior occipital, not vmPFC (`results/summary.json`, `results/fwe_clusters.csv`, `results/top_voxels.csv`).
